concept_name: Western Continent Food Chain and Species Invasion
english_name: Western Continent Food Web with Invasive Species
ecological_definition: Food web: the network of energy flow and predation relationships in an ecosystem; invasive species alter the structure of the food web

trophic_levels.name: Secondary consumers · local demons
trophic_levels.characteristics: No backing · lone operators · easily eliminated

trophic_levels.name: Top predators · invasive demons
trophic_levels.characteristics: Mounts descended from the Celestial Court / Spirit Mountain · no natural enemies · must be reclaimed by their owners

trophic_levels.name: Super-top controllers · pilgrimage team
trophic_levels.energy_source: Does not participate in energy flow (external intervention)
trophic_levels.characteristics: External intervention force · eliminates invasive species

trophic_levels.name: Ultimate regulators · Celestial Court / Spirit Mountain

before_invasion.ecosystem_balance: Stable · local demons and mortals in balance

during_invasion.ecosystem_balance: Imbalanced · invasive demons have no enemies · mortals eaten en masse

after_invasion.top_predator: After the pilgrimage team passes · no demons remain
after_invasion.ecosystem_balance: Mortals recover · but local demons are also cleared
after_invasion.removal_mechanism: The pilgrimage team ‘clears the field’ · ecological homogenization

food_web_insights: The Western Continent food web has 6 trophic levels · 2 more than a natural ecosystem
Invasive species occupy level 4 · no local enemies · disrupting energy flow
The pilgrimage team is an external intervention force · it does not participate in energy flow
The Celestial Court / Spirit Mountain is the ultimate regulator · it both manufactures and reclaims invasions
After the pilgrimage team passes · ecological homogenization (mortals dominate · demons cleared)
It is essentially ‘institutional species invasion’: the Celestial Court / Spirit Mountain creates problems and then solves them
